findings.rationale: Re-derived: an E1 overrun exits 4 and writes nothing (stage-advance decide returns code 4 with bump_to; no patch). The red run at base (commit 7ba74598) printed 'E1 from a linked worktree measures that worktree (1 file fits S): expected [0] got [4]', and verify-red-green.sh (p1/red-green.json, VALIDATED, base_exit_code 1) confirms the suite is red at base. The exit-code assertion is not vacuous.

Real edge: followRepoRoot returns early on a marker without a string repo_root, and both cmdSetInit call sites then passed undefined to applyInitFields. Fixed: next.repo_root || repoRoot at both call sites.

Bindings exist: scopeFromCwd is imported at scripts/session-mode.js:91 and markerRepoIdentity is a hoisted function declaration in the same file; stage-advance.js imports scopeFromCwd explicitly. The D5 tests pass (205/0), which they could not if either were unbound.
No defect, as the finding itself says: equal local and remote give the same merge-base, so the stored sha is identical either way.
Scope note, not a defect: P2-P4 are later phases with their own per-phase review.
Cheap hardening taken: the foreign-repo and follow-back set calls now pass increasing sizes (L, XL) and assert the size was written, so the repo_root assertions cannot pass on a refused write.
